source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 17 exercise solved (PDF 81-82): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short, long and inquisitive questions, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 17 (Human Reproductive System) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Short Q7 ke paanch joron ka farq table mein hai. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Fertilization of the ovum occurs in:
(Ovum ki fertilization kahan hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ovulation ke baad ovum oviduct mein aata hai; fertilization wahin hoti hai aur zygote oviduct hi mein taqseem hona shuru karta hai (17.1.2).

blocks.prompt:
2. Which cells of the testis secrete testosterone hormone?
(Testis ke kaun se cells testosterone banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: LH seminiferous tubules ke darmiyan maujood Leydig cells se testosterone banwata hai; Sertoli cells banne wale sperms ko ghiza dete hain (17.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
3. The site of the production of sperm is:
(Sperm kahan bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Spermatogenesis testes ki seminiferous tubules ki germinal epithelium mein hoti hai; epididymis sirf inhein rakhta aur harkat ke qabil banata hai (17.1.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (d) mein "Vas deference" chhapa hai; sahi naam vas deferens hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Which part produces fructose-rich fluid for the sperm?
(Sperm ke liye fructose wala fluid kaun banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har seminal vesicle fructose (cheeni) se bharpoor fluid chhorti hai jo sperm ko energy deta hai (17.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
5. In males, which hormone initiates spermatogenesis?
(Mardon mein spermatogenesis kaun sa hormone shuru karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Anterior pituitary ka FSH seminiferous tubules ko spermatogenesis par uksata hai; LH Leydig cells par asar karta hai (17.1.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (b) ka label "b)" chhapa hai, shuru wali bracket ke baghair; yeh sirf chhapai ki ghalti hai, option (b) hi hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. During ovulation which cell is actually released from ovary?
(Ovulation mein ovary se asal mein kaun sa cell nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Puberty par primary oocyte meiosis I mukammal kar ke secondary oocyte banata hai jo metaphase II mein ruk jata hai aur yahi ovary se nikalta hai; meiosis II sirf sperm milne par mukammal hoti hai (17.1.2).

blocks.prompt:
7. Which hormone stimulates the Graafian follicle to release ovum?
(Kaun sa hormone Graafian follicle se ovum nikalwata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Din 14 par anterior pituitary se LH ka achanak ikhraj Graafian follicle se ovum nikalwata hai (ovulation) (17.1.2).

blocks.prompt:
1. Briefly describe the function of seminal vesicles, prostate gland, and bulbourethral glands.
Seminal vesicles, prostate gland aur bulbourethral glands ka kaam mukhtasaran bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh madadgar (accessory) glands sperms mein fluid mila kar semen banati hain.
1. Seminal vesicles: fructose wala fluid vas deferens mein dalti hain jo sperms ko energy deta hai.
2. Prostate gland: semen ka taqreeban 60% fluid banati hai.
3. Bulbourethral glands: saaf fluid jo urethra ko chikna karta aur sperms ko mehfooz neutral mahol deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. When do the ova in a females begin meiosis? When do they complete the first meiotic division?
Aurat mein ova meiosis kab shuru karte hain? Pehli meiotic division kab mukammal hoti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Meiosis larki ki embryonic nashonuma (maa ke pait mein) ke dauran shuru hoti hai: oogonia mitosis se primary oocytes banate hain jo meiosis I shuru kar ke prophase I mein ruk jate hain aur poora bachpan isi haal mein rehte hain.
Meiosis I puberty ke baad mukammal hoti hai, har cycle mein ek primary oocyte (ovulation se pehle), jis se secondary oocyte aur pehli polar body banti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "the ova in a females" chhapa hai; sahi "in a female" ya "in females" hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Write a brief note on the role of FSH, LH and testosterone in man.
Mard mein FSH, LH aur testosterone ke kirdar par mukhtasar note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Hypothalamus ka GnRH anterior pituitary se FSH aur LH nikalwata hai.
1. FSH seminiferous tubules mein spermatogenesis karwata hai (aur Sertoli cells se inhibin nikalwata hai jo mazeed FSH rokta hai).
2. LH Leydig cells se testosterone banwata hai.
3. Testosterone germinal epithelium ki nashonuma karta, sperm banne ke liye zaroori hai aur mard ki secondary sexual khususiyaat qaim rakhta hai; yeh mazeed LH aur GnRH ko rokta hai (negative feedback).

blocks.prompt:
4. List the structures of female reproductive system.
Female reproductive system ke hisson ki fehrist likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Gonads: do ovaries (ovarian follicles samet).
2. Oviducts (fallopian ya uterine tubes).
3. Uterus: fundus, body aur cervix; deewar ki teen tehein perimetrium, myometrium aur endometrium.
4. Vagina.
Oviducts, uterus aur vagina madadgar (accessory) aaza hain.

blocks.prompt:
5. What changes occur in ovulation and menstruation during gestation period.
Hamal (gestation) ke dauran ovulation aur menstruation mein kya tabdeeliyan aati hain?
blocks.explanation: Hamal mein dono ruk jate hain. Embryo human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) banata hai jo corpus luteum ko qaim rakhta hai, is liye estrogen aur progesterone zyada rehte hain (baad mein placenta bhi progesterone banata hai). Zyada progesterone endometrium ko mota rakhta hai, is liye menstruation nahi hoti, aur FSH ko rokta hai, is liye naye follicles nahi pakte aur ovulation band rehti hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. What is the role of the corpus luteum in a menstrual cycle?
Menstrual cycle mein corpus luteum ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Ovulation ke baad LH phate hue Graafian follicle ko peele (yellow) corpus luteum mein badal deta hai. Yeh estrogen aur progesterone banata hai jo endometrium ko zyada khoon wala aur glandular banate hain taa ke embryo jam sake (secretory phase). Fertilization na ho to yeh khatam ho jata hai; estrogen aur progesterone gir jate hain aur endometrium utar jata hai (din 28 par menstruation).

blocks.prompt:
7. Differentiate between:
• Primary and secondary spermatocytes
Primary aur secondary spermatocytes mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono seminiferous tubules mein spermatogenesis ke marahil hain.

rows: Primary spermatocyte se meiosis-I ke zariye
Meiosis-II kar ke spermatids banate hain

blocks.prompt:
7. Differentiate between:
• Spermatogenesis and oogenesis
Spermatogenesis aur oogenesis mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono meiosis se haploid gametes banate hain, magar jagah, waqt aur natije mein farq hai.

rows: Embryonic zindagi mein shuru; puberty tak prophase I mein ruka
Ek primary oocyte se ek ovum aur polar bodies
Meiosis II sirf sperm milne par mukammal

blocks.prompt:
7. Differentiate between:
• Sertoli cell and Leydig cell
Sertoli cell aur Leydig cell mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono testis ke cells hain magar kaam alag hain.

rows: Seminiferous tubules ki deewar (germinal epithelium) mein
Seminiferous tubules ke darmiyani tissue mein
Banne wale sperms ko ghiza; in ka fluid sperms ko epididymis tak le jata hai
FSH par kaam; inhibin chhorte hain

blocks.prompt:
7. Differentiate between:
• Spermatids and spermatozoa
Spermatids aur spermatozoa mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Spermatids pak kar spermatozoa bante hain.

rows: Secondary spermatocytes se meiosis-II ke zariye
Lambe, sar (acrosome), midpiece aur dum wale
Epididymis mein harkat paate hain; ovum ko fertilize kar sakte hain

blocks.prompt:
7. Differentiate between:
• Primary oocyte and secondary oocyte
Primary oocyte aur secondary oocyte mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono oogenesis ke marahil hain.

rows: Embryonic zindagi mein oogonia se mitosis ke zariye
Puberty ke baad primary oocyte se meiosis-I ke zariye
Ovulation mein nikalta hai; fertilize ho to meiosis-II mukammal

blocks.prompt:
1. Describe the structure of human male reproductive system. Identify the function of each part.
Insaan ke male reproductive system ki banawat bayan karein. Har hisse ka kaam batayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Gonads (testes): do bayzavi (oval) testes (3-5 cm × 2-3 cm) pait se bahar scrotum (theli) mein (taqreeban 34°C par, jo sperm ke liye zaroori hai). Har testis lipti hui seminiferous tubules se bana hai; in ki germinal epithelium mein germline cells (meiosis se sperms) aur Sertoli cells (sperms ko ghiza) hain. Tubules ke darmiyan Leydig cells testosterone banate hain.
2. Accessory ducts (naaliyan): rete testis (sperms lene wala jaal) → epididymis (lambi lipti nali; sperms kam az kam 18 ghante reh kar harkat ke qabil bante hain) → vas deferens (inguinal canal se pait mein jati hai) → seminal vesicle ki nali se mil kar ejaculatory duct → dono ejaculatory ducts prostate se guzar kar urethra mein khulti hain, jo penis ke zariye sperms (aur peshab) bahar le jati hai.
3. Accessory glands (semen banati hain): seminal vesicles (fructose wala fluid, energy), prostate gland (semen ka taqreeban 60% fluid), bulbourethral glands (urethra ko chikna karne wala saaf fluid, neutral mahol).
4. Copulatory organ (penis): is mein urethra, erectile tissue, ek artery aur do veins hain; sperms ko aurat ke jism mein pohanchata hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain the major reproductive hormones of human male and explain their role.
Insaani mard ke bare reproductive hormones aur un ka kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Spermatogenesis aur mard ka reproduction hypothalamus, pituitary aur testes ke hormones control karte hain:
1. Gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH), hypothalamus se: anterior pituitary se FSH aur LH nikalwata hai.
2. Follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH): seminiferous tubules mein spermatogenesis karwata hai.
3. Luteinizing hormone (LH): Leydig cells (darmiyani tissue) se testosterone banwata hai.
4. Testosterone (androgen): germinal epithelium ki nashonuma, normal sperm banne ke liye zaroori; reproductive aaza ko pakata hai; mard ki secondary sexual khususiyaat aur sex drive paida aur qaim rakhta hai.
5. Inhibin (Sertoli cells ka peptide, FSH ke asar se): mazeed FSH ko rokta hai.
Negative feedback: inhibin FSH ko had mein rakhta hai aur testosterone LH aur GnRH ko rokta hai, yun hormones ka tawazun qaim rehta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Silsila yaad karein: Hypothalamus (GnRH) → Anterior pituitary (FSH + LH) → FSH: Sertoli/tubules = sperm; LH: Leydig = testosterone. Wapsi ka rasta (feedback): inhibin → FSH band; testosterone → LH aur GnRH band.

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain the structures of human female reproductive system. Identify the function of each part.
Insaan ke female reproductive system ke hisson ki wazahat karein. Har hisse ka kaam batayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Ovaries (gonads): do bayzavi ovaries (3-5 cm × 2-3 cm), uterus ke dono taraf. Yeh anday (egg cells) aur hormones (estrogen, progesterone) banati hain. In mein ovarian follicles hain jo kachche anday paalte hain; har mahine ek follicle anda chhorta hai (ovulation) aur corpus luteum ban jata hai.
2. Oviducts (fallopian/uterine tubes): ovaries se uterus tak do naaliyan; ovum ko lete aur cilia ke zariye uterus ki taraf le jate hain; fertilization aur zygote ki pehli mitotic taqseem yahin.
3. Uterus: khokhla muscular uzw jis ke hisse fundus (upar), body (bara hissa) aur cervix (neeche ka tang hissa jo vagina mein khulta hai). Deewar: perimetrium (bahar ki patli teh), myometrium (smooth muscles ki moti teh), endometrium (andar ki naram teh; basal layer mein stem cells aur functional layer jo har cycle mein moti ho kar utarti hai). Yeh embryo ko jamata hai; is ki khoon wali jagahein placenta banati hain jo foetus ko oxygen aur ghiza deti hai.
4. Vagina: cervix se bahar tak 8-10 cm patli deewar wali nali; bachche ki paidaish aur menstrual flow ka rasta.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe the events of a menstrual cycle and explain its hormonal regulation.
Menstrual cycle ke waqiaat aur is ka hormonal control bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Menstrual cycle aurat ke reproductive system ke dohraye jane wale waqiaat ka silsila hai, taqreeban 28 din ka.
1. Menstrual phase (din 1-5): estrogen aur progesterone kam hone se endometrium ki functional layer khoon ke saath utarti hai (menstruation, 3-5 din). FSH barhna shuru hota hai.
2. Proliferative phase aur ovulation (din 6-14): barhta FSH chand follicles barhata hai; sirf ek Graafian follicle banta hai jo ovary ki satah par aata hai. FSH is se estrogen banwata hai jo endometrium ko khoon wala aur dobara mota karta hai. Barhta estrogen FSH ko kam karta hai (negative feedback), aur din 14 par anterior pituitary LH ka achanak ikhraj karti hai jo Graafian follicle se ovum oviduct mein nikalwata hai (ovulation).
3. Secretory (ovulation ke baad) phase (din 15-28): LH phate follicle ko corpus luteum banata hai jo estrogen aur progesterone chhorta hai; endometrium mazeed khoon wala aur glandular banta hai. Fertilization na ho to corpus luteum khatam, LH band, estrogen aur progesterone achanak girte hain aur endometrium utar jata hai (din 28 par menstruation); cycle dobara shuru.
Agar ovum fertilize ho jaye to embryo hCG banata hai jo corpus luteum ko qaim rakhta, estrogen aur progesterone zyada rakhta aur menstruation rokta hai. Taqreeban 50 saal ki umar mein cycle ruk jata hai (menopause).

rows: Estrogen aur progesterone kam; endometrium utarta hai; FSH barhna shuru
FSH Graafian follicle barhata hai; estrogen endometrium dobara banata hai; din 14 par LH ka ubhaar ovulation karata hai
LH corpus luteum banata hai; estrogen + progesterone endometrium ko glandular karte hain; dono girne se menstruation

blocks.prompt:
1. List the structures in order, through which a sperm passes on its way from the seminiferous tubules to the outside.
Un hisson ki tarteeb-war fehrist likhein jin se sperm seminiferous tubules se bahar tak guzarta hai.
blocks.explanation: Seminiferous tubules → rete testis → epididymis → vas deferens → ejaculatory duct (prostate gland ke andar se) → urethra (penis mein) → bahar.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe the effect of endocrine disrupting contaminants on the reproductive abilities.
Hormones mein khalal dalne wale aloodgi ke ajza (endocrine disrupting contaminants) ka reproductive salahiyat par asar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
(Chapter se bahar.) Endocrine disrupting contaminants mahol ke woh kimiyai maddey hain (maslan kuch keeray-maar dawaiyan jaise DDT, plastic ke ajza jaise bisphenol A aur phthalates, dioxins, bhaari dhaatein) jo qudrati hormones ki naqal karte ya unhein rok dete hain. Reproduction GnRH, FSH, LH, testosterone, estrogen aur progesterone se chalta hai, is liye yeh maddey tawazun bigaar dete hain:
1. Mardon mein: testosterone kam, sperms ki tadaad aur meyaar kam, reproductive aaza ki ghalat nashonuma.
2. Aurton mein: be-qaida menstrual cycle aur ovulation, waqt se pehle puberty, zarkhezi (fertility) mein kami.
3. Hamal mein: foetus aur us ke reproductive aaza ko nuqsan, hamal zaya hone ka khatra.
Yun yeh insaanon aur janwaron ki reproductive salahiyat kam kar dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
3. Why are so many sperms produced in the male and so few ova produced in the female?
Mard mein itne zyada sperms aur aurat mein itne kam ova kyun bante hain?
blocks.explanation:
Sperms: puberty se spermatogenesis musalsal hoti hai aur ek spermatogonium se chaar sperms bante hain. Bohat zyada sperms is liye chahiye ke zyada tar aurat ke jism ke lambe raste mein mar jate ya zaya ho jate hain (chapter se bahar: tezabiyat, faasla, immune hamla), aur ek sperm ko ovum tak pohanchane aur andar dakhil karwane mein bohat se sperms madad karte hain; sperm chhota hai aur banana sasta hai.
Ova: tamam primary oocytes paidaish se pehle ban jate hain aur har mahine sirf ek pakta hai; ek primary oocyte se sirf ek ovum banta hai (cytoplasm usi ko milta hai, polar bodies khatam ho jati hain). Ovum bara hai aur ghiza jama rakhta hai, aur uterus aam tor par ek waqt mein ek hi embryo paal sakta hai, is liye kam magar bare ova bante hain.
